# Psalm 93 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 93:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Established your-throne from-then; from-everlasting you-are.
- **LOGOS:** Your throne is established from of old; you are from everlasting.
- **PNEUMA:** Your throne has been in place since the beginning; you have existed from all eternity.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 93:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Have-lifted the-rivers O-YHWH, have-lifted the-rivers their-voice; lift the-rivers their-crashing.
- **LOGOS:** The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their roaring.
- **PNEUMA:** The rivers are roaring, LORD — the rivers are raising their voices — the rivers are thundering!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 93:4 (overlap: 6%)

- **EMET:** More-than voices-of waters many, majestic breakers-of the-sea, majestic on-high YHWH.
- **LOGOS:** Mightier than the thunders of many waters, mightier than the waves of the sea, the LORD on high is mighty!
- **PNEUMA:** But mightier than the roar of raging waters, mightier than the crashing waves of the sea — the LORD above is mightier than them all!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 93:5 (overlap: 7%)

- **EMET:** Your-testimonies are-very-sure; holiness befits your-house, O-YHWH, to-length-of days.
- **LOGOS:** Your decrees are very trustworthy; holiness befits your house, O LORD, forevermore.
- **PNEUMA:** Your laws stand absolutely firm. Holiness is the beauty of your house, LORD — forever and ever.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 93:1 (overlap: 9%)

- **EMET:** YHWH reigns; majesty he-has-clothed-himself; has-clothed-himself YHWH strength he-has-girded-himself; surely is-established the-world, not it-will-be-moved.
- **LOGOS:** The LORD reigns; he is robed in majesty; the LORD is robed; he has put on strength as his belt. Yes, the world is established; it shall never be moved.
- **PNEUMA:** The LORD is king! He has dressed himself in majesty! The LORD has clothed himself and armed himself with strength. The world stands firm — it cannot be shaken.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
